name: @gitdocai/render
description: Renders a documentation (MDX) to HTML and writes the published bundle to a directory or to R2.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
